# testing_oas_write_only (Resource)

OASWriteOnly Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_write_only" "my_oaswriteonly" {
  array_of_objects_with_mixed_writeonly = [
    {
      api_key  = "...my_api_key..."
      password = "...my_password..."
      username = "...my_username..."
    }
  ]
  deep_nested_with_writeonly_leaf = {
    level1_name = "...my_level1_name..."
    level2 = {
      level2_name = "...my_level2_name..."
      level3 = {
        level3_name = "...my_level3_name..."
        level4 = {
          encryption_key = "...my_encryption_key..."
          level4_name    = "...my_level4_name..."
          secret_key     = "...my_secret_key..."
        }
      }
    }
  }
  map_of_objects_with_writeonly = {
    key = {
      api_token        = "...my_api_token..."
      db_password      = "...my_db_password..."
      environment_name = "...my_environment_name..."
    }
  }
  object_no_writeonly = {
    object_level_1_no_writeonly = {
      string_level_2_no_writeonly = "...my_string_level_2_no_writeonly..."
      string_level_2_writeonly    = "...my_string_level_2_writeonly..."
    }
    object_level_1_writeonly = {
      string_level_2_no_writeonly = "...my_string_level_2_no_writeonly..."
      string_level_2_writeonly    = "...my_string_level_2_writeonly..."
    }
    string_level_1_no_writeonly = "...my_string_level_1_no_writeonly..."
    string_level_1_writeonly    = "...my_string_level_1_writeonly..."
  }
  object_writeonly = {
    object_level_1_no_writeonly = {
      string_level_2_no_writeonly = "...my_string_level_2_no_writeonly..."
      string_level_2_writeonly    = "...my_string_level_2_writeonly..."
    }
    object_level_1_writeonly = {
      string_level_2_no_writeonly = "...my_string_level_2_no_writeonly..."
      string_level_2_writeonly    = "...my_string_level_2_writeonly..."
    }
    string_level_1_no_writeonly = "...my_string_level_1_no_writeonly..."
    string_level_1_writeonly    = "...my_string_level_1_writeonly..."
  }
  string_no_writeonly = "...my_string_no_writeonly..."
  string_writeonly    = "...my_string_writeonly..."
  union_with_partial_writeonly = {
    token = {
      created_at = "2021-08-06T05:39:21.170Z"
      token_id   = "...my_token_id..."
      token_name = "...my_token_name..."
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `array_of_objects_with_mixed_writeonly` (Attributes List) Array containing objects with some write-only fields (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--array_of_objects_with_mixed_writeonly))
- `deep_nested_with_writeonly_leaf` (Attributes) 4 levels deep with write-only at leaf level (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deep_nested_with_writeonly_leaf))
- `map_of_objects_with_writeonly` (Attributes Map) Map containing objects with write-only fields (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--map_of_objects_with_writeonly))
- `object_no_writeonly` (Attributes) no writeOnly object (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--object_no_writeonly))
- `object_writeonly` (Attributes) writeOnly object (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--object_writeonly))
- `string_no_writeonly` (String) no writeOnly string property
- `string_writeonly` (String) writeOnly string property
- `union_with_partial_writeonly` (Attributes) Union - only password variant has write-only (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--union_with_partial_writeonly))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_write_only.my_testing_oas_write_only
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_write_only.my_testing_oas_write_only "..."
```
